mapper.insert: insert into TRM_SATISFY_TEMP (TEMP_ID, TEMP_NAME, TEMP_NO, QUES_TYPE, TEMP_STAT, QUES_CONT) values (#{tempId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{tempName,jdbcType=DECIMAL},#{tempNo,jdbcType=DECIMAL},#{quesType,jdbcType=DECIMAL},#{tempStat,jdbcType=DECIMAL},#{quesCont,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT b.TEMP_ID, b.TEMP_NAME, b.TEMP_NO, b.QUES_TYPE, b.TEMP_STAT, b.QUES_CONT, a.CONT FROM (SELECT TEMP_NO,CONT FROM TRM_SATISFY_JOURNO where JOURNO = #{journo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by temp_no) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT TEMP_ID, TEMP_NAME, TEMP_NO, QUES_TYPE, TEMP_STAT, QUES_CONT FROM TRM_SATISFY_TEMP WHERE TEMP_ID = #{tempId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) b on (a.TEMP_NO = b.TEMP_NO) order by TEMP_NO
mapper.insert: insert into TRM_SATISFY_JOURNO (JOURNO, TEMP_NO, QUES_TYPE, CONT) values (#{journo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{tempNo,jdbcType=DECIMAL},#{quesType,jdbcType=DECIMAL},#{cont,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: update trm_course_libs set course_score = (select avg(cont) as eval_score from trm_satisfy_journo where journo in (select journo from trm_satisfy_log where course_id = #{courseId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) and ques_type = 1 ) where course_id = #{courseId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
